project.name: Brownhills
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 8 of 13: every visitor category, strict boundary, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, construction dates, access, transport and dogs were rechecked before continuing. St Andrews, Boarhills and Cambo attractions are not transferred. Private farm and residential access is not promoted.

touristAppeal.label: Limited Visitor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Brownhills is a minor farmstead locality, not an independent visitor destination. The Rock and Spindle walk passes the Brownhills cottages, but starts at St Andrews East Sands and is therefore related route context rather than town merit.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Responsible rural access may be possible on public routes, but no dedicated dog visit or dog-welcoming venue is evidenced.

townGuide.headline: Recorded for regional completeness, not promoted as a visitor stop
townGuide.intro: Brownhills is a minor farmstead locality, not an independent visitor destination. The Rock and Spindle walk passes the Brownhills cottages, but starts at St Andrews East Sands and is therefore related route context rather than town merit.
perfectFor: Passing only when already on a lawful route

suggestedFirstVisit.title: No dedicated visit recommended
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Use only signed public access and do not assume private farm or estate access.

townGuide.visitorMood: Selector-only, with no borrowed attraction value.

townStudyArea.sourceName: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
